changelog.note: Initial capture as user 1. Only Compact mode and Product updates are ever switched by tests and are put back through the UI by a fixture. Password and key inputs are never typed into; Update password, Replace key, Save key, Remove key, Sign out all other sessions, Enable (2FA), Export Data, Delete Account, Adjust plan and See Plans are never used. Balances, figures and key state are live data and never asserted by value.
